verdict.rationale: Daytona supplies the runtime for autonomous background work: sandboxes are created and driven programmatically through Python/TypeScript SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, and Computer Use automates GUI interactions. However, no evidence shows a built-in way to define, schedule or trigger automations, so users must write their own orchestration with the SDKs or an external agent. missing for 10: native automation/scheduling or trigger features (cron, event hooks, background jobs), documented long-running autonomous task management, hands-on corroboration of background automation workflows.
